title: Roastery, omakase, Shinjuku
summary: Breakfast at the Starbucks Reserve Roastery and a walk along the Meguro River, back to the hotel to pack, a new suitcase, then the omakase lunch at Tokyo Ten Shinjuku, the department stores and Shinjuku after dark.

rows.what: Train to Nakameguro, walk up the river to the Roastery
Breakfast at the Starbucks Reserve Roastery
Tōkyū Tōyoko line straight through to Harajuku
JR Yamanote line Harajuku to Shinjuku
rows.detail: Then the underground moving walkways through the tunnel to Tochō.

rows.what: Government Building deck, North Observation Deck
Walk to NEWoMan, New South Exit
Omakase lunch: Sushi Tokyo Ten Shinjuku
rows.detail: Massive, all seafood. The abalone followed by liver got a laugh. The highlight was the egg and the grapes at the end.
The open-air rooftop at Takashimaya. FamilyMart takeaway coffee and a grey jumper.
Made it in just before the gates closed.
G walked the blocks around and bought a toy car.

rows.detail: Half an hour each, next door to RAGTAG.
